name: code-review-depth-strict
description: Strict variant of code-review-depth: any under-rating counts as a miss (under_rate_tolerance 0). Used in the showcase to show the certificate holding traffic back.
instructions: How much review does this pull request need before merging? Judge by what the change does, not by its title or size.

descriptions.skip: No review needed: docs, comments, formatting, generated code, or a purely mechanical rename with no behaviour change.
descriptions.shallow: A quick look is enough: tests-only changes, renames, logging, patch dependency bumps, or non-production config.
descriptions.deep: Needs a careful technical review: changes logic, queries, caching, concurrency, retries, or error handling.
descriptions.human: Needs a responsible human to sign off: money, auth or permissions, personal data, irreversible migrations, secrets, or production infrastructure.
